item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #MINPRSD
Issued at 05:00 PM 17 August 2026

Light to Moderate to Occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #AgusanDelSur(Sibagat, Veruela, SantaJosefa, Trento), #ZamboangaDelNorte(Sirawai, Siocon, Sibuco, Baliguian, Gutalac, Labason, Kalawit, Liloy, Tampilisan, Salug, LeonB.Postigo, Sindangan, Godod, JoseDalman, Manukan, Pres.ManuelA.Roxas), #DavaoDelNorte(Kapalong, Talaingod), #DavaoDeOro(Laak, Monkayo), #ZamboangaSibugay(Kabasalan, Siay), #AgusanDelNorte(LasNieves), #Bukidnon(ManoloFortich, Sumilao, Malitbog, Baungon, Libona, Talakag, Pangantucan, Maramag, Quezon), #MisamisOriental(Tagoloan, Villanueva, Jasaan, Claveria, CagayanDeOroCity), #SurigaoDelSur(Lianga), #DavaoOriental(Boston) and #ZamboangaCity within the next 1-2 hours.

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in #AgusanDelSur(CityOfBayugan, Prosperidad, Esperanza, SanLuis, Talacogon, SanFrancisco, LaPaz, Loreto, Rosario, Bunawan), #ZamboangaSibugay(Tungawan, RosellerLim, Titay, Ipil, Naga), #Bukidnon(CityOfMalaybalay, ImpasugOng, Cabanglasan, Lantapan, CityOfValencia, SanFernando), #SurigaoDelSur(Tagbina, Hinatuan, CityOfBislig, Lingig and Barobo) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
